ClauseAcknowledgement.description: The Microsoft clause text the console showed and the administrator confirmed.
ClauseAcknowledgement.title: ClauseAcknowledgement

CorpusCreation.description: A new corpus: uploaded recordings with a source declaration, or the Edge test teacher.
CorpusCreation.title: CorpusCreation

CorpusDetail.description: The review table: the summary and every line.
CorpusDetail.title: CorpusDetail

CorpusLine.description: One recording of a corpus with its transcript and review state.
CorpusLine.title: CorpusLine

CorpusSummary.description: A training corpus (訓練語料) with its source, usage label and trainability.
CorpusSummary.title: CorpusSummary

EdgeClause.description: The Microsoft clause the console shows and sends back verbatim.
EdgeClause.title: EdgeClause

ErrorBody.description: The JSON body of every non-2xx response; ``detail`` is shown to operators.
ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody

FragmentEnvelope.description: The turn identity a fragment carries; built from the core's TurnEnvelope.
FragmentEnvelope.title: FragmentEnvelope

LibraryVoice.description: A reference recording of the voice library (參考音訊庫).
LibraryVoice.title: LibraryVoice

LineConfirmation.description: Confirm every pending line with a transcript, or only ``line_ids``.
LineConfirmation.title: LineConfirmation

LineEdit.description: A new transcript (the line goes back to pending) and/or a review state.
LineEdit.title: LineEdit

LineUpload.description: The fields sent with one uploaded recording (the audio is the body).
LineUpload.title: LineUpload

PlayableFragment.description: A reply fragment the core cut and the TTS layer synthesizes.
PlayableFragment.title: PlayableFragment

SynthesisRequest.description: One playable fragment in one voice.
SynthesisRequest.title: SynthesisRequest

TextListReview.description: An administrator's text list for an Edge corpus, one sentence per line.
TextListReview.title: TextListReview

TrainingActivity.description: Whether a training job holds the GPU; the core refuses new stages meanwhile.
TrainingActivity.title: TrainingActivity

TrainingCheck.description: One named reason a training job may or may not start; ``detail`` has the numbers.
TrainingCheck.title: TrainingCheck

TrainingJob.description: A training job (訓練工作): from a corpus to a voice model in the catalog.
TrainingJob.title: TrainingJob

TrainingJobState.description: The running job, else the latest finished one; ``None`` when there is none.
TrainingJobState.title: TrainingJobState

TrainingLog.description: Log lines from absolute line ``start``; ``next`` is where the following page starts.
TrainingLog.title: TrainingLog

TrainingStart.description: Start a job; an Edge corpus also names a voice and a preset or its own text list.
TrainingStart.title: TrainingStart

TrainingStatus.description: The job, the layer's pre-flight checks and the settings the console shows.
TrainingStatus.title: TrainingStatus

TranscriptFile.description: An uploaded same-name ``.txt`` file or ``metadata.csv``; base64 in JSON.
TranscriptFile.title: TranscriptFile

TranscriptionProgress.description: The automatic transcription job of a corpus; ``idle`` when it has none.
TranscriptionProgress.title: TranscriptionProgress

TtsCatalog.description: What a role's voice is chosen from.
TtsCatalog.title: TtsCatalog

TtsEngineSettings.description: What every voice of the process shares (``PUT /engine``).
TtsEngineSettings.title: TtsEngineSettings

TtsModel.description: A BreezyVoice model folder under ``models/``, named by its catalog ID.
TtsModel.title: TtsModel

TtsVoice.description:
The voice a role speaks with: its engine and what that engine needs.

``voice`` is an Edge voice name, a voice-library ID (BreezyVoice) or a
voice-model ID (Matcha); ``server`` a loopback BreezyVoice address and
``model`` a ``models/`` catalog ID, "" for the defaults. All are IDs the
core validated (CODING_STANDARDS rule 1), never paths.
TtsVoice.title: TtsVoice

UnresolvedFragment.description: A token the digit normaliser would not guess; offsets index the original text.
UnresolvedFragment.title: UnresolvedFragment

VoiceModelInfo.description: A voice model (聲線模型) under ``models/tts`` with its usage label.
VoiceModelInfo.title: VoiceModelInfo

VoiceModelPreview.description: A preset sentence in a voice model's voice; no text of the caller's own.
VoiceModelPreview.title: VoiceModelPreview

VoicePreparation.description: Make a voice ready to speak: start its BreezyVoice server, warm Edge.
VoicePreparation.title: VoicePreparation

VoiceServerStatus.description: Whether a voice's BreezyVoice server answers with its model now.
VoiceServerStatus.title: VoiceServerStatus

VoiceUpload.description: The fields sent with an uploaded reference recording.
VoiceUpload.title: VoiceUpload
